name: Address
description: Address search with suggestions from the field's lookup source (e.g. Google Places, key kept on the server), stored as a structured address with coordinates. Manual entry as a fallback.

props.name: debounce_ms
props.label: Wait after typing (ms)
props.description: How long to wait after the last keystroke before searching.

props.name: allow_manual
props.label: Allow manual entry
props.description: Shows "Enter the address manually": street, city, region, postcode and country inputs.

props.name: show_details
props.label: Show address details
props.description: Shows the parsed street, city, region, postcode, country and coordinates under the field.

props.name: country_hint
props.label: Country hint
props.description: Appended to every search as ", <country>" (e.g. New Zealand) to favour addresses in that country.

output.description: The formatted address; <key>_parts has street, city, region, postcode, country and coordinates

accessibility.keyboard: Type at least three characters to search. Down / Up move through the suggestions, Enter chooses one, Escape closes the list (a second Escape clears the field). "Enter the address manually" shows separate inputs.

author: UserTasks
